Constant monitoring and maintenance are the pre requisites while transporting perishable goods over long durations. Axestrack provides a complete solution dedicated to the refrigerated transport industry sector providing real-time temperature and location information throughout the transport and storage time. It is indispensable in ensuring a safe and dependable cool-chain and ensures you are alerted the moment a temperature of the chamber goes out of the threshold value. In fact it monitors all aspects of the performance of the fridge unit.
Real time monitoring of temperature levels
Information is sent back at periodic intervals
Increased shelf life of fruits and vegetables
Safe delivery of temperature sensitive goods especially pharmaceutical products. For eg some medicines need to be kept at a certain temperature span only else they get spoiled.
Eliminates loss of perishable goods and high value contents
Customer are happier with in time and improved quality of delivery
Enhanced customer satisfaction knowing goods have been transported under appropriate temperature conditions
Complete peace of mind knowing that the stored product is being constantly maintained in optimum conditions
